# 17 · Monitoring, evaluation and fine-tuning

Operate an agent: traces, metrics, dashboards, and when to fine-tune.

**Optional packages:** `observability` (installed when this module is built).

**Services:** `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `PROMETHEUS_URL`, `GRAFANA_URL`, each set in `.env`; lessons skip cleanly when one is missing.
